company_description: Prysmian S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces, distributes, and sells power and telecom cables and systems, and related accessories under the Prysmian, Draka, and General Cable brands worldwide. It operates through four segments: Transmission, Power Grid, Electrification, and Digital Solutions. The company offers high voltage direct current (HVDC), network component high voltage, submarine power, submarine telecom, offshore specialties, and EOSS high voltage units. It also provides power distribution, overhead lines, high voltage alternate current (HVAC), network component medium voltage/low voltage, EOSS medium voltage/low voltage units. In addition, it offers electrification products; and fiber optics, optical cables, connectivity components and accessories, optical ground wire cables, and copper cables. Further, it manufactures and sells thermoplastic and metal enclosures. Prysmian S.p.A. was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

revenue_by_customer_type.rationale: Les extraits fournis concernent uniquement l'analyse des créances clients et des provisions pour créances douteuses de Prysmian Group (câbles et systèmes d'énergie). Aucune information sur le mix B2B/B2C n'est présente dans ces données comptables. Prysmian opère historiquement en B2B pur (clients industriels, énergétiques, télécom), sans activité IA significative.
